result.title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
result.summary: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RevFlow，把图像生成视为编码的逆过程：以冻结视觉编码器的中间表示为逐级生成目标，先生成深层语义表示，再生成保留外观与空间细节的浅层表示，最后解码到像素；并用共享 DiT 骨干、按阶段注入条件的 HyC-DiT 统一各阶段，借助语义表示空间的原生匹配实现少步生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其沿编码器深度逐级生成隐状态、共享骨干加阶段条件注入以及少步匹配采样的设计，可能为 LVR 中多层级 latent 状态的构建与高效更新提供方法线索，阶段间细节保留与条件注入方式可供核查。
